# ADA.gov

> > The official source for Americans with Disabilities Act information, regulations, and compliance guidance from the U.S. Department of Justice.

ADA.gov provides comprehensive information about the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, including legal requirements, accessibility standards, and enforcement resources. The site serves businesses, government agencies, and individuals seeking to understand and comply with disability rights protections.

## Key Topics

- Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)
- Title II (State & Local Government)
- Title III (Public Accommodations)
- ADA Standards for Accessible Design
- Web and Mobile Accessibility
- Disability Rights
- Accessibility Compliance
- Civil Rights Enforcement
- Service Animals
- Design Standards
- Employment Discrimination
- Public Accommodations
- Department of Justice
- Rehabilitation Act
- Accessibility Requirements

## Core Information & Overview

- [The Americans with Disabilities Act](https://www.ada.gov): Homepage introducing the ADA and its protections for people with disabilities
- [Topics](https://www.ada.gov/topics): Topic overviews covering ADA areas: service animals, parking, communication
- [Guidance & Resource Materials](https://www.ada.gov/resources): Detailed guidance documents and compliance briefs on ADA requirements

## Laws, Regulations & Standards

- [Law, Regulations & Standards](https://www.ada.gov/law-and-regs): ADA regulations, standards, and legal requirements for compliance
- [Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, As Amended](https://www.ada.gov/law-and-regs/ada): Full text of ADA law including 2008 amendments from Congress
- [Regulations](https://www.ada.gov/law-and-regs/regulations): DOJ regulations for Title II and Title III compliance obligations
- [Title II Regulations](https://www.ada.gov/law-and-regs/regulations/title-ii-2010-regulations): Title II regulations for state and local government accessibility
- [Title III Regulations](https://www.ada.gov/law-and-regs/regulations/title-iii-regulations): Title III regulations for business and public accommodation accessibility

## Accessibility Design Standards

- [ADA Standards for Accessible Design](https://www.ada.gov/law-and-regs/design-standards): ADA Standards for physical accessibility of buildings and facilities
- [2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design](https://www.ada.gov/law-and-regs/design-standards/2010-stds): 2010 accessibility standards for newly designed or altered facilities
- [Guidance on the 2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design](https://www.ada.gov/law-and-regs/design-standards/standards-guidance): Guidance explaining 2010 standards changes and compliance requirements
- [State and Local Governments: First Steps Toward Web and Mobile Application Accessibility](https://www.ada.gov/resources/web-rule-first-steps): Guide for web and mobile app accessibility compliance for governments
- [Title II Web & Mobile Application Accessibility Rule Webinar](https://www.ada.gov/title-ii-web-rule): Webinar explaining Title II web accessibility rule requirements

## Compliance & Enforcement

- [File a Complaint](https://www.ada.gov/file-a-complaint): Steps to file ADA discrimination complaints with federal agencies
- [Cases](https://www.ada.gov/cases): DOJ enforcement cases and settlements advancing disability rights
- [Expanding Your Market: Tax Incentives for Businesses](https://www.ada.gov/resources/tax-incentives-businesses): Federal tax credits and deductions for disability access improvements

## Support & Contact

- [Help](https://www.ada.gov/help): Help center with FAQs and resources for ADA questions and complaints
- [ADA Information Line](https://www.ada.gov/infoline): Contact information for ADA Information Line with accessibility specialists
- [Community Outreach Coordinator](https://www.ada.gov/communityoutreach): Community outreach and speaker bureau contact for ADA presentations

## Optional

- [ADA Standards for Accessible Design Title III Regulation 28 CFR Part 36 (1991)](https://www.ada.gov/law-and-regs/design-standards/1991-design-standards): 1991 design standards for government and commercial facility accessibility
